name: Torch & SOS
description: Turn on your phone's flashlight, send SOS in Morse code, use a strobe or light up the screen.
prompt: A flashlight app that uses my phone's real torch through Acornix, with a big power button, SOS in Morse code, an adjustable strobe and a coloured screen light.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Enciende la linterna del móvil, manda SOS en Morse, usa un estroboscopio o ilumina la pantalla.
